messages:
kevin (Release Lead): Heads-up — planning deploy to prod @ 2025-11-05 18:00 UTC. Can folks confirm rollback runbook + criteria? Need go/no-go by 17:45.

maria (Prod Eng): I reviewed the runbook, link here: https://internal.docs/redwood/deploys/rollback-playbook. Key rollback command below.

```
# rollback to previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-server inference-server=redwood/inference:v2025.10.12-rc
# verify pods restart
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-server --timeout=5m
```

sam (Eng SRE): I'll own the rollback execution and watch. I'll be on-call in the deploy window and keep the incident channel open.

sam (Eng SRE): Quick smoke checklist I'll run right after deploy: 1) 200/200 on /health endpoints (10 samples), 2) sample inference requests (chat + embeddings), 3) tail error logs for 2 mins, 4) k8s pod restarts 0.

anita (PM): Any expected user-visible behavior? If we need rollback criteria, propose: error rate >1% sustained for 5m OR P95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m OR new 5xx spikes.

maria (Prod Eng): Agree with criteria. Also add: model output regression alerts from eval hooks (if regression >= 3 fail cases in alert set -> trigger).

kevin (Release Lead): Noted. Criteria summary: (a) 5xx or error rate >1% for 5m, (b) P95 >2x baseline for 5m, (c) eval/regression alerts >=3. If any met -> rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window at 2025-11-05T18:00Z by kevin. Notifying oncall@sre and eng-releases.

anita (PM): PM + product analytics will watch funnel metrics for 30m post deploy. I'll post if conversion drop >4% vs baseline.

maria (Prod Eng): Runbook checklist is staged in the doc (preflight -> canary -> full rollout). Canary size = 5% for 10m. If canary passes smoke checks -> proceed to 100%.

sam (Eng SRE): Monitoring hooks: dashboards/inference/latency, dashboards/inference/errors, logging query saved: `namespace:inference AND (level:ERROR OR status:[500 TO 599])`

kevin (Release Lead): OK — last call for questions. Who's on watch? @sam confirmed, @maria will validate traces, @anita product watch.

maria (Prod Eng): I'll validate traces + run automated smoke scripts at canary start.

sam (Eng SRE): I'll trigger rollback if criteria met, and call for a postmortem if rollback happens.

anita (PM): No blockers from product.

kevin (Release Lead): All right — team check-in at 17:45 for final go/no-go. If no objections, I'll mark GO and kick at 18:00. :rocket:

kevin (Release Lead): 17:46 update — all green from watchers. GO for 18:00.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2025-11-05T18:00:12Z — canary (5%). Logs: https://cd.redwood/deploys/1758234567

maria (Prod Eng): Canary smoke run: /health 10/10 OK, sample chat 5/5 OK, no new errors in logs (tailing for 2m).

sam (Eng SRE): Watching metrics — error rate 0.12% stable, P95 ~ baseline. No anomalies.

anita (PM): Funnels steady — no drop noted.

kevin (Release Lead): Canary looks good. Proceeding to full rollout now.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% started at 2025-11-05T18:12:03Z.

maria (Prod Eng): Post-rollout smoke: health 10/10, sample inference 15/15, traces look normal.

sam (Eng SRE): Final check — error rate 0.09%, P95 normal. No rollback needed.

kevin (Release Lead): Deploy complete. No rollback triggered. Thanks team — will file a short post-deploy note and update the release checklist. :tada:
